name: Byrnes Boulevard Waterfall Garden
description: The backyard on Byrnes Boulevard was built around the water. A stone waterfall feeds a stream you can cross as you walk the garden, with planted beds, pine straw, and walks leading back toward the house. We graded the slope so the water stays in the stream and the paths stay dry.
metaDescription: Backyard on Byrnes Boulevard in Florence with a stone waterfall, a stream you can cross, planted beds, and walks back to the house.
story: The lot slopes down toward the marsh, so the backyard had to work with that. We built a stone waterfall and stream you can walk through, with crossings over the water and a patio and walks back toward the house. The beds around it are planted and finished with pine straw and mulch. It's graded so the water stays in the stream and the walks stay dry.
